description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer rectangular-area checkpoint: safe Rust owns overlap-safe wide-glyph horizontal movement, DEC rectangular fill/erase/attribute/copy behavior, and line-rendition-aware rectangular copy from double-width source rows.

entries.notes: The safe row/rect owners move the Microsoft Japanese wide-glyph fixture one cell right and left through ICH, DCH, overlapping rectangular copy and ScrollRegion-like movement without self-erasing or splitting a two-cell glyph.

rect_ops reproduces all six Microsoft data rows: DECFRA fill, DECERA standard erase, DECSERA protected-aware text erase with attributes retained, DECCARA rectangular rendition/color patching, DECRARA intensity reversal and overlap-safe DECCRA copy, while preserving cells outside the target rectangle.

DECCRA source screen coordinates are projected through each row's LineRendition, so a 20-screen-column source slice contributes 20 cells on single-width rows and 10 cells on the double-width row, preserving glyphs and attributes exactly at the destination.
